definitions.explanation: A dry substance in the form of fine particles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小麦|こむぎ}{粉|こ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make bread with wheat flour.

examples.english: This dish uses potato starch to thicken it. You can also substitute wheat flour.

notes:
{粉|こな} means powder or flour.

TYPES OF FLOUR/POWDER:
- ⟦{小麦|こむぎ}{粉|こ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧ (wheat flour)
- ⟦{米|こめ}{粉|こ}→米粉：13771_komeko⟧ (rice flour)
- ⟦{片栗|かたくり}{粉|こ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧ (potato starch)
- {粉|こな}⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧ (powdered cheese)
- ⟦{粉|こな}ミルク→粉ミルク：21060_konamiruku⟧ (powdered milk)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {粉|こな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to grind into powder)
- {粉|こな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まぶす→まぶす：18477_mabusu⟧ (to coat with powder)
- {粉|こな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ふるう→ふるう：noentry⟧ (to sift flour)

NOTE ON READINGS:
- As a standalone word: こな
- In compounds: often こ (e.g., ⟦{小麦|こむぎ}{粉|こ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{粉|ふん}{末|まつ}→粉末：13772_funmatsu⟧ (powder, powdered form)
- ⟦{粉|ふん}{状|じょう}→粉状：25189_funjou⟧ (powdery, in powder form)
